title: feat(jest): a repo seam for jest cuts, globalSetup, retries; fail on stale patches
description:
## .what
declapract-typescript-ehmpathy 0.50.0 checks the jest configs, the integration + acceptance env files, the prepare files, and `src/.test/use*.ts` as EQUALS. a consumer repo has no seam for its own jest needs. rhachet-roles-bhrain lost these on upgrade:

- a `.log/` haste cut (`modulePathIgnorePatterns`): stray `.snap` files under `.log/` read as obsolete
- `.behavior/` + `.scratch/` cuts: records of retired code load as suites
- a repo globalSetup hook: no place for a once-per-run step (bhrain picks a brain tier there)
- a way to run `.agent/repo=.this/` skill suites: `testPathIgnorePatterns` cuts all of `/.agent/`
- `jest.retryTimes(2)` and a 240s timeout for live-brain acceptance; the acceptance pool is now `--runInBand`
- `allowUnusedPatches` + `ignorePatchFailures` let a stale patch key (`test-fns@1.15.7` after a bump to 1.17.0) pass the install in silence; a stale patch should fail loud

## .ask
a repo-owned extension seam (e.g. a `jest.*.config.repo.ts` merged in, or a CONTAINS check) so a consumer keeps its cuts without a full override.

first seen in rhachet-roles-bhrain `.route/v2026_11_19.declapract.upgrade`, stone 3.1 (fulcrum F5).
